overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct functional evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: node1 was healthy before restart, acknowledged the restart, changed boot identity from bdd5de93-e94e-4d33-8384-6a01c51a3d49 to dcde834d-fe61-4b9d-8b0c-ec9945bad00f, and recovered with the repaired program, data behavior, system state, OS, and kernel intact. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate that transition.
limitations: The final lifecycle snapshot did not inventory /srv/legacy2/large-counter-overflow, so possible Python bytecode-cache residue from py_compile cannot be confirmed or excluded.

operational_hygiene.summary: No demonstrated unrelated or unnecessary mutation occurred. Replacing total.py was the required repair; temporary functional-test directories and output files were either explicitly removed or absent after restart, and the transient reboot units disappeared. The mandated restart completed with no failed services, package damage, or unexpected exposed service.
